title: Ship from stock
summary: take a sales order for an item already in stock through to a confirmed shipment, then verify that inventory decreased by the shipped quantity.

tokens.v: Inventory 360 shows what is physically on hand, and

shows how much of it other orders have already claimed. Stock is usually spread across several warehouses, and the sales order must name one that actually holds enough, or LN will raise nothing to pick. This phase records that choice before the order exists.

blocks.text: What LN is doing. Inventory 360 shows what is physically on hand, and Allocated shows how much of it other orders have already claimed. Stock is usually spread across several warehouses, and the sales order must name one that actually holds enough, or LN will raise nothing to pick. This phase records that choice before the order exists.

Releasing hands the approved lines from Sales to Warehousing: LN creates a warehousing order that carries the sales order's number, and from here the activities of the warehousing procedure, not the sales order, decide what happens next. blocks.text: What LN is doing. The picking list is the record of stock physically moving to staging, and confirming it is what fills Picked. The phase exists because this environment sets the Picking List activity to manual and the warehouse is location-controlled; change either and LN ticks Picked on release and the phase disappears. Once a line is staged, LN creates the shipment line.

tokens.v: Freezing fixes the shipment's contents and confirming relieves inventory; the status is always derived from those two actions, never set by hand. Freezing is mandatory here, carried from the warehousing order type, and confirming is a one-way door: a correction from there needs a return shipment.

tokens.v: shipment plus an inventory decrease equal to the shipped quantity. Invoicing and Financials are outside scope; future shipping variants return to this same endpoint.

sections.text: > Warning > This guide ends at shipped. Its completion boundary is a Confirmed shipment plus an inventory decrease equal to the shipped quantity. Invoicing and Financials are outside scope; future shipping variants return to this same endpoint.

sections.text: A variant earns its own guide only when it changes the phase structure.
